verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for a cloud email service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents SES region selection or residency controls. Delivering received mail to an S3 bucket and encrypting it with KMS are adjacent features of other AWS services, not a documented SES region or residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
